sharedShellEscape.title: Allow external commands in this shared project?
sharedShellEscape.message: Anyone who can edit this project could then run programs on this computer when you compile. Only allow this if you trust everyone in the project.

cookieImport.title: Confirm cookie import
cookieImport.copyHost: Copy the cookies for {{hostname}} from {{browser}} profile "{{profile}}" into Oleafly? They can sign you in to {{hostname}}.
cookieImport.copyAll: Copy every cookie from {{browser}} profile "{{profile}}" into Oleafly? They can sign you in to websites.

mcpCommand.title: Run this program?
mcpCommand.environment: It also sets these environment variables: {{names}}

trustFolder.title: Trust this folder?
trustFolder.message: Oleafly will turn on Git, the terminal, agents and LaTeX tools for {{name}}. Only trust folders whose contents you know.
trustFolder.messageParent: Oleafly will trust {{name}} and every folder inside it, including ones you open later.
trustFolder.messageRepository: Oleafly will run Git in {{name}} with the repository's own settings and hooks.

restrictedWrite.title: Allow this change?
restrictedWrite.message: The assistant wants to change {{path}}. Files like this can run programs, and this folder isn't trusted yet.

restrictedNetwork.title: Allow this request?
restrictedNetwork.message: The assistant wants to use {{tool}}, which sends text to an online service. This folder isn't trusted yet.

rebindFolder.title: Use a different folder?
rebindFolder.message: {{name}} isn't the folder Oleafly had for this project. If you use it, Oleafly saves your unsaved changes there and closes this project's terminals and agent sessions. Anything running in them ends. Oleafly also stops trusting the folder, turns off Full Access, resets the assistant's approvals and unlinks research folders. Chats and history are kept.

saveCopy.title: Choose where to save a copy

agentProgram.title: Use this program?
agentProgram.message: Oleafly will start {{path}} whenever you use {{name}}. Only choose programs you trust.

sharedCodeExecution.title: Allow code in this shared project?
sharedCodeExecution.message: Compiling will then run the code in this project on this computer. Anyone with edit access can change that code. Only allow this if you trust everyone in the project.

desktopApps.signedIn: This acts in your own signed-in browser.
desktopApps.signedInOn: This acts in your own signed-in browser, on {{origin}}.

started.body: Research tasks you marked to keep running continue in the background. Open Oleafly to see their progress.
